verdict.rationale: Shopify documents an official Shopify CLI for generating and working with apps, themes and custom storefronts, including a single-command install and `shopify app dev` for connecting to dev stores (shopify-docs-17, shopify-docs-30, shopify-docs-x2, shopify-probe-4). For AI-native use, the AI Toolkit connects AI coding tools to the CLI's store management (shopify-docs-53). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documented agent-friendly CLI features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive modes.
